topic.source_contract: nationally significant infrastructure DCO pre-application examination decision requirements delivery

scope_guards: A project announcement is not treated as an accepted DCO application.
Acceptance for examination is not treated as development consent.
An Examining Authority recommendation is not treated as the Secretary of State decision.
A made DCO is not treated as discharged requirements or constructed delivery.
A land plan is not treated as completed acquisition or possession.
A draft DCO requirement is not treated as a discharged requirement.
National Policy Statement support is not treated as project approval.
No score or promotion is written without exact project, accepted application, decision, land powers, requirement discharge and delivery evidence.
